description: Small synthetic mechanism tests, not a general agent benchmark
statistics: mean and sample standard deviation across 3 model seeds; 2048 heldout queries per seed per case

manifest.task: random permutation facts; final answer only; fresh worlds each batch
limitations: lossless fact writes are engineered, not learned
NOOP does not overwrite archived facts
GRU and archive differ in memory capacity; only detach/joint isolate backward connectivity
single uses one-hop training; its training compute and task distribution differ
judge auxiliary targets use task truth; this is not DeepSeek replication or self-reward RL
no continual-learning or language capability claim

manifest.reward: binary sampled_action == target; real environment feedback only
manifest.critic: final-step score predicts sampled binary reward; earlier scores feed the next internal step
manifest.checkpoint_selection: fixed last; validation curves never choose a checkpoint
limitations: Small synthetic task adaptation, not DeepSeek reproduction or lifelong learning
Lossless record storage and writes are engineered
All arms start with identical weights; critic enables feedback and can differ at step 0
The critic score does not observe the sampled action; it estimates policy success probability
Shared-core BCE and score feedback change together in the critic arm
